lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
List three adaptation steps that stay respectful for a cleared story.

Strong answer: 'Credit source; keep core events; state it is a retelling; avoid sacred restricted material.'

Changing a cultural story to make jokes about the culture. Humour must not demean.

Adapt by keeping core events, updating language for clarity and stating you are retelling. Do not take First Nations restricted stories. Offer roles beyond heroes so many students participate.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner make intentional visual, music, drama or dance choices and name their effect, rather than saying an artwork is simply “nice”. Keep every claim linked to an element or technique.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the elements, techniques or performance choices that carry the idea. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided.
